name: PD 181 was established by Ordinance No. 18371, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 29, 1984. Ordinance No. 18371 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18371; 25508)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 181 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-181.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 181 was established by Ordinance No. 18371, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 29, 1984. Ordinance No. 18371 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18371; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-181.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 181 is established on property generally located on the north side of Camp Wisdom Road, west of Polk Street. The size of PD 181 is approximately 21.994 acres. (Ord. Nos. 18371; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-181.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-181.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. Development must be in accordance with the development plan that is labelled Exhibit 181A. (Ord. Nos. 18371; 25508)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-181.105.LANDSCAPE PLAN. Landscaping must be provided in accordance with the landscape plan that is labelled Exhibit 181B. (Ord. Nos. 18371; 25508)

sections.title: Phasing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-181.106.PHASING.
(a)Construction must be in the following order in accordance with the development plan as follows:
(1) Phase 1: October 1, 1984.
(2) Phase 2: April 1, 1985.
(3) Phase 3: April 1, 1986.
(4) Phase 4: September 1, 1986.
(5) Phase 5: September 1, 1985.
(6)Phase 6:May 1, 1987.
(b)Construction must begin on or before the above dates, contingent upon financing and approval of a subdivision plat by the city plan commission. (Ord. Nos. 18371; 25508)

sections.title: Uses And Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-181.107.USES AND DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS.
(a)Development within Phase 1 is limited to nonresidential uses permitted in an O-2 Office District. All buildings and structures are limited to a maximum height of 160 feet and a maximum of six stories. Maximum lot coverage is 12,000 square feet. Otherwise, development of Phase 1 must comply with O-2 Office District standards.
(b)Development within Phase 2 is limited to single-family uses consisting of a maximum of 50 dwelling units, each with a maximum height of 36 feet, and otherwise, development of Phase 2 must comply with TH-3 Townhouse District standards.
(c)Development within Phase 3 is limited to single-family uses consisting of a maximum of 20 dwelling units, each with a maximum height of 36 feet, and otherwise, development of Phase 3 must comply with TH-3 Townhouse District standards.
(d)Development within Phase 4 is limited to single-family uses consisting of a maximum of 34 dwelling units, each with a maximum height of 30 feet and a maximum of three stories, and otherwise, development of Phase 4 must comply with TH-3 Townhouse District standards.
(e)Development within Phase 5 is limited to a private recreational club, including a club house, swimming pool, and tennis courts, as shown on the development plan. All buildings and structures are limited to a maximum height of 24 feet.
(f)Development of Phase 6 is limited to single-family uses consisting of a maximum of 16 dwelling units, each with a maximum height of 24 feet, and otherwise, development of Phase 6 must comply with TH-1 Townhouse District standards. (Ord. Nos. 18371; 25508)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-181.108.PARKING. Parking must be provided in accordance with the requirements of the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 18371; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-181.109.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Utilization of the Property must comply with all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18371; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-181.110.PAVING. All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 18371; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-181.111.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there is full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18371; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-181.112.ZONING MAP. PD 181 is located on Zoning Map No. P-6. (Ord. Nos. 18371; 25508)
